rateRule.expression: (http.host eq "app.cutiutamagica.eu" and http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_serverFn/")) or (http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/v1/reviewer/login")

beforeActivation: Confirm exact Free plan parameters and current ruleset via Cloudflare before applying
Test owner/staff login and shared-IP bursts in pilot
Verify checkout, OAuth, signed webhooks, SEO crawlers and AI runner remain unaffected
Keep app-level KDF throttling, CSRF, RBAC and signed webhook checks
Do not use Everyone, Bypass, country blocks or generic SQL keyword filters
